from asgiref.sync import async_to_sync
from channels.layers import get_channel_layer
from rest_framework.views import APIView
from rest_framework.response import Response
from rest_framework.permissions import IsAuthenticated
from .models import PerformanceReview, Employee

class SubmitPeerReviewView(APIView):
    permission_classes = [IsAuthenticated]

    def post(self, request, target_employee_id):
        target = Employee.objects.get(id=target_employee_id, company=request.user.company)
        feedback = request.data.get('feedback_text')
        score = request.data.get('score')

        review = PerformanceReview.objects.create(
            evaluator=request.user,
            subject=target,
            feedback=feedback,
            score=score
        )

        # Broadcasts review feedback to entire company channel instead of reviewer committee
        channel_layer = get_channel_layer()
        async_to_sync(channel_layer.group_send)(
            f"company_{request.user.company.id}_reviews",
            {
                'type': 'review.new_submission',
                'target_id': target.id,
                'feedback': feedback,
                'score': score
            }
        )
        return Response({'status': 'review_submitted'})

corrected_code:
from asgiref.sync import async_to_sync
from channels.layers import get_channel_layer
from rest_framework.views import APIView
from rest_framework.response import Response
from rest_framework.permissions import IsAuthenticated
from .models import PerformanceReview, Employee

class SubmitPeerReviewView(APIView):
    permission_classes = [IsAuthenticated]

    def post(self, request, target_employee_id):
        target = Employee.objects.get(id=target_employee_id, company=request.user.company)
        feedback = request.data.get('feedback_text')
        score = request.data.get('score')

        review = PerformanceReview.objects.create(
            evaluator=request.user,
            subject=target,
            feedback=feedback,
            score=score
        )

        # Restrict broadcast strictly to the authorized HR management group for this employee
        channel_layer = get_channel_layer()
        async_to_sync(channel_layer.group_send)(
            f"company_{request.user.company.id}_hr_management",
            {
                'type': 'review.new_submission',
                'target_id': target.id,
                'feedback': feedback,
                'score': score
            }
        )
        return Response({'status': 'review_submitted'})
